tools.description: Quick scan of one page (the URL you pass, usually the home page): Lighthouse mobile scores (performance, accessibility, best practices, SEO) with LCP/CLS/TBT/page weight/requests, plus HTTPS redirect, TLS, HSTS and security headers, title, meta description, H1, image alt texts, viewport, canonical,
